description: Search photos of real places taken by NUM travelers and offered for licensing per use. Each result has a photo_id, a preview URL, the place (name, city, area, category), the month it was taken, the photographer's public name and the price in US cents for each use: social (one post), web (one page), ad (one campaign) and ai_training (one dataset). A price of null means that use is not offered. Every photo shows a place with no recognisable person and was checked by a person; results never include coordinates or exact dates. use=ai_training returns only photos whose photographer allows AI training. Each call counts against the daily read quota.

city.description: A NUM destination or neighbourhood, e.g. 'London' or 'Silom'.

place_id.description: Only photos of this place (from num_search_places).

q.description: Free text matched against the place name.

use.description: Only photos offered for this use.

name: num_search_photos
title: Search licensable photos of places
